Installation

Prerequisites

Requirement

Notes

QGIS ≥ 3.0

Bundled with Python 3 and GDAL

Python 3.x

Provided by the QGIS installer

GDAL

Provided by the QGIS installer

shapely

Must be installed separately (see below)

requests

Must be installed separately (see below)

Installing Python dependencies

Open the OSGeo4W Shell (available in the Start Menu after installing QGIS) and run:

pip install shapely requests

Note

Do not use a regular terminal or Anaconda environment — the packages must be installed into the Python that QGIS uses.

Deploying the plugin

Option 1 — Copy manually

Copy the Optical-Downloader/ folder to the QGIS plugins directory:

C:\Users\<your-username>\AppData\Roaming\QGIS\QGIS3\profiles\default\python\plugins\

The folder name inside the plugins directory must be Optical-Downloader.

Enabling the plugin

  1. Open QGIS.

  2. Go to Plugins → Manage and Install Plugins.

  3. Select the Installed tab.

  4. Tick the checkbox next to Optical Downloader.

The plugin icon (🛰) appears in the QGIS toolbar.
